D/ [--]ALEN S PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Victory left issue of 364-378, Reece period 19, Arles mint. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ALEN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: *CONS.
